variants.specifics: Brackenford: Garrick at the north gate, shut by Reeve Halvard because of Red Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Halt! The north gate stays shut till Halvard says otherwise. Red Corwin's bandits own that road now.

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: You again? The gate's still shut, lad.

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: The north gate is open again! Brackenford owes you a great deal, brave Adventurer.

variants.specifics: Kroth: Hask keeps the Deep Gate, shut by Guildmaster Brummel while Ulgrim's dead walk the Old Deeps.

first.speaker: Hask
first.text: Halt! The Deep Gate is shut by order of Guildmaster Brummel. The dead are walking down there!

again.speaker: Hask
again.text: Move along. I've got my orders.

later.speaker: Hask
later.text: Guildmaster Brummel has given you leave to go below. Open the gate! Good luck, Adventurer.

variants.specifics: Gloam: Tobbin at the Plank Gate on the north boardwalk, shut by Mayor Grimbol because the Undead come up out of the bog.

first.speaker: Tobbin
first.text: Halt! No one passes the Plank Gate. Mayor Grimbol's orders! There's Undead out in that bog, stranger, and plenty of 'em.

again.speaker: Tobbin
again.text: I said the gate is shut. Now move along!

later.speaker: Tobbin
later.text: The Mayor says you may pass. Watch your step out there -- some of those planks are rotten clean through!

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: Tobin, guard at the east gate, shut by Commander Holgrim until the main quest opens it.

first.speaker: Tobin
first.text: Welcome to Durnhelm, stranger! No Undead has ever set foot inside these walls, and none ever will while the Iron Watch stands guard! The east gate stays shut, though. Commander Holgrim's orders.

later.speaker: Tobin
later.text: Commander Holgrim says you may pass. The gate is open. Watch yourself out on the moor, lad!

variants.specifics: Ostra: Brannoc keeps the causeway gate out to Gorm Isle, shut by Mayor Odrick because the dead walk the causeway at night.

first.speaker: Brannoc
first.text: Sorry, stranger. Nobody crosses the causeway without Mayor Odrick's say-so. The dead walk it after dark.

again.speaker: Brannoc
again.text: I said the gate's shut. Off with you!

later.speaker: Brannoc
later.text: Mayor Odrick has given his word. The causeway is open to you. Good luck!

variants.specifics: Ardoth: Brannoc at the west gate, shut by Archmaster Quellan while Malgor's Skeletons walk the road.

first.speaker: Brannoc
first.text: Halt! The west gate is shut by order of Archmaster Quellan. Skeletons walk the road out there.

again.speaker: Brannoc
again.text: Still here? Move along. Nobody passes.

later.speaker: Brannoc
later.text: So you're the one the Archmaster was talking about! The gate is open. Off you go, and watch yourself on the road!

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: Tormod at the East Gate, shut by Warden Brannoc while Kolgrath's Undead walk the pass.

first.speaker: Tormod
first.text: Halt! The East Gate is shut by order of Warden Brannoc. Nobody goes up the pass while the Undead are on it.

again.speaker: Tormod
again.text: You again? The gate's shut. Go and get warm by the fire in the Iron Kettle.

later.speaker: Tormod
later.text: The Warden says you may pass. Go on through. And mind the ice!

variants.specifics: Vulmar: Hulgar keeps the mountain gate of Vulmar, shut by Mayor Dravik while the Ogres hold the Old Foundry.

first.speaker: Hulgar
first.text: Halt! Nobody goes up the mountain road. Mayor Dravik's orders. The Ogres would have you for supper!

again.speaker: Hulgar
again.text: I said nobody goes up. Go pester somebody else.

later.speaker: Hulgar
later.text: Mayor Dravik has opened the road for you. Watch your head up there -- the Ogres have been throwing rocks.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: Dalt at the east gate of Kesrin, shut by Mayor Fennick against Ravek's Undead on the east road.

first.speaker: Dalt
first.text: Halt! No one goes out the east gate. Mayor Fennick's orders! Ravek's Undead walk that road after dark.

later.speaker: Dalt
later.text: Mayor Fennick gave the word. The gate is open, brave Adventurer -- you may pass. Watch yourself out there.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Dobbs keeps the north gate, shut by Mayor Bellock's order since the Ogres came.

first.speaker: Dobbs
first.text: Halt! Nobody goes out the north gate. Mayor Bellock's orders. The Ogres would have you for supper before you got past the turnip fields!

again.speaker: Dobbs
again.text: Move along, lad. The gate stays shut.

later.speaker: Dobbs
later.text: The Mayor says you may go. Open the gate! And good luck to you, brave Adventurer.
